notes: No reboot before the session: the system had been up since 2026-10-06 12:41 (about 11.5 h); the protocol requires a reboot before every session. The heat test and the smoke test ran in the same boot.

Start-up transient: rounds 1-2 (00:17-00:33) show +3-10 % CPU J/token and lower tokens/s for almost every model; values settle from round 3. Excluding rounds 1-2 changes absolute means by at most 2 % and the ratios to 8B-Q8_0 by at most 0.01 (interleaving spread the transient over all models).

The idle baseline (16.39 W, 4.1 % CPU utilisation, just below the 5 % warning limit) was measured during that transient; net (idle-subtracted) values of this session are less reliable than the raw values.
Isolated outliers occur after round 2 as well (largest: round 10, 8B-Q8_0 'transformer', 18.67 J/token).
Final use of session_01 (in the main tables, or treated as an outlier session) will be decided after sessions 02-03 are available. Until then the data is kept unchanged.
